title: 第25章 回归与救治第26章 遗迹资格赛
lines: 林澈带着三枚逻辑结晶回到青云城时，已是深夜。
妙手堂内灯火通明，赵虎虽然还不能下床，但已经能靠在床头喝粥了。
周老和白雨都在，见到林澈平安归来，都松了口气。
“林大夫，您可算回来了！”
周老接过林澈的行囊，“幻梦沼泽那边动静不小，整个东南方向天空都扭曲了，我们还担心您……”
“出了点意外，但任务完成了。”
林澈取出三枚逻辑结晶放在桌上。
结晶在烛光下折射出七彩的光芒，内部仿佛有无数细小的符号在流动。
白雨看得入神，伸手想碰，被林澈制止。
“别碰，这东西直接接触会影响思维。”
林澈小心地用特制的玉盒装好，“逻辑结晶蕴含纯粹的‘逻辑法则’，未经处理直接接触，轻则头疼欲裂，重则变成逻辑怪物。”
白雨吓得调皮地伸了伸舌头。
“林兄弟，接下来怎么办？”
赵虎问道，声音还有些虚弱，但中气明显的足了许多。
林澈坐到床边，给他把了把脉：“恢复得不错，龙血芝的药效已经完全吸收了。
你现在感觉如何？”
“感觉……浑身是劲儿！”
赵虎眼睛发亮，“而且脑子里好像清醒了很多，以前修炼时想不通的一些关窍，现在突然就明白了。”
“这是龙血芝强化了你的悟性。”
林澈笑道，“好好调养，等你痊愈，我教你一套适合你现在体质的炼体功法。”
赵虎激动得差点从床上蹦起来。
“躺好。”
林澈按住他，转身对周老和白雨道，“接下来三天，我要闭关炼制‘认知疫苗’。
妙手堂暂时停诊，任何人不见。”
“明白。”
两人点头。
林澈又对白雨说：“你继续收集情报，尤其留意天机阁的动向。
我这次在幻梦沼泽，感觉有人在暗中监视我。”
白雨脸色一肃：“我会注意的。”
安排好一切，林澈带着逻辑结晶和其他材料，进入了妙手堂地下的密室。
这密室是他不久前让周老找人挖的，用导灵银和隔灵石做了屏蔽，能隔绝大部分探测。
密室不大，只有三丈见方，但足够安静，也很安全。
林澈将《第七医官防疫手册》摊开，仔细研读疫苗的炼制步骤。
疫苗炼制分三步：
第一步，净化逻辑结晶。
用纯净的“秩序灵力”
洗练结晶，去除其中可能残留的混乱杂质。
第二步，注入医疗法则碎片。
将碎片中的“治愈”
与“秩序”
法则，与结晶中的“逻辑法则”
融合，形成疫苗的“核心模板”
第三步，加入辅助材料。
content_en:
It was already late at night when Lin Che returned to Qingyun City with three logic crystals.
The lights in Miaoshou Hall were brightly lit. Although Zhao Hu could not get out of bed yet, he could already lean on the bedside and drink porridge.
Mr. Zhou and Bai Yu were both there, and they were relieved to see Lin Che return safely.
"Doctor Lin, you are finally back!"
Mr. Zhou took Lin Che's luggage and said, "There is a lot of movement in the Dream Swamp. The sky in the southeast direction is distorted. We are still worried about you..."
"There was an accident, but mission accomplished."
Lin Che took out three logic crystals and placed them on the table.
The crystal reflects colorful light under the candlelight, and there seem to be countless tiny symbols flowing inside.
Bai Yu was fascinated by the sight and reached out to touch it, but Lin Che stopped her.
"Don't touch it. Direct contact with this thing will affect your thinking."
Lin Che carefully packed it in a special jade box. "Logical crystals contain pure 'logic rules'. If they are directly exposed to it without treatment, it will cause a splitting headache at the least, and turn into a logic monster at worst."
Bai Yu was so frightened that he stuck out his tongue playfully.
"Brother Lin, what should we do next?"
Zhao Hu asked, his voice still a little weak, but his energy was obviously much stronger.
Lin Che sat by the bed and took his pulse: "He is recovering well, the effects of Dragon Blood Mushroom have been fully absorbed.
How are you feeling now? "
"I feel... full of energy!"
Zhao Hu's eyes were bright, "And my mind seems to be much clearer. Some of the key points that I couldn't figure out when I was practicing are now suddenly clear to me."
"This is Dragon Blood Mushroom that strengthens your understanding."
Lin Che smiled and said, "Take good care of yourself. When you recover, I will teach you a set of body-building exercises suitable for your current physique."
"Really?!"
Zhao Hu was so excited that he almost jumped out of bed.
"Lie down."
Lin Che held him down, turned to Mr. Zhou and Bai Yu and said, "In the next three days, I will be in seclusion to refine the 'cognitive vaccine'.
Miaoshou Tang temporarily closed its clinic and no one was seen. "
"Understood."
The two nodded.
Lin Che said to Bai Yu again: "Continue to collect intelligence, especially pay attention to the movements of Tianji Pavilion.
This time I was in Dream Swamp, and I felt like someone was spying on me. "
Bai Yu's face became solemn: "I will pay attention."
After arranging everything, Lin Che took the logic crystal and other materials and entered the secret room under the Miaoshou Hall.
He asked Mr. Zhou to find someone to dig this secret room not long ago. It was shielded with spiritual silver and spiritual stone, which could block most detections.
The secret room is not big, only three feet square, but it is quiet enough and safe.
Lin Che spread out the "Seventh Medical Officer's Epidemic Prevention Manual" and carefully studied the vaccine refining steps.
Vaccine refining is divided into three steps:
The first step is to purify the logical crystallization.
Use pure "spiritual power of order"
Wash the crystals to remove any messy impurities that may remain in them.
The second step is to inject the medical law fragments.
"Cure" from the fragments
and "order"
Laws, and "logical laws" in crystallization
Fusion to form the "core template" of the vaccine
The third step is to add auxiliary materials.
